title: Lower bound on the Ramsey number $r(4,4)$
statement: Write $r(4,4)$ for the least $n$ such that every simple graph on $n$ vertices contains either a clique on $4$ vertices or an independent set of $4$ vertices. Then $r(4,4) \ge 18$.
hypotheses_covered: none — a lower bound on r(4,4)
replaced:
\emph{\texttt{r(4, 4) $\ge$ 18}.}

\[r(4, 4) \geq 18 \qquad (7.11)\]

with the matching upper bound (\S{}7.2, p. 114):

\[r(4, 4) \leq r(4, 3) + r(3, 4) = 18\]
which, together with [...] (7.11), respectively, yield [...] $r(4, 4) = 18$.
